compat: Plugin minimum: vfox {min_version}. Use current vfox for the commands in this guide.
install_title: A few commands. Then you’re in.
install_description: Check the platform requirements, then choose your version manager. The examples pin a version; search to find other available releases.
copy_error: Select the command and copy it manually
guide_title: From the first install to your daily run.
guide_project_title: Keep the version with the project
guide_project_text: Initialize vfox in Bash and select the project version. With mise, use mise use to select a version for the current project.
faq1_question: How do I find other versions?
faq4_question: How do I update the plugin?
closing_text: Find the source, report an issue or explore the releases on GitHub.
footer_text: An independent vfox plugin documentation site.
hero_description: Manage etcd, etcdctl and etcdutl with vfox or mise. Install release binaries or build a failpoint version for robustness testing.
feature1_text: The etcd release package supplies the server, etcdctl and etcdutl.
feature2_text: On Unix-like systems, BUILD_WITH_FAILPOINT=yes enables a source build.
feature3_text: Use the vfox: backend in mise without maintaining a second plugin.
linux_deps: The default installs upstream release binaries. Failpoint builds need Go 1.21+, GNU Make and source build tools.
macos_deps: Normal installation uses release binaries. Failpoint mode needs Go, Make and build tools.
windows_deps: Uses upstream Windows release archives. Failpoint source builds are not supported.
guide_tools_text: Run the tools in the selected environment with exec, without relying on global PATH.
guide3_text: Set the build option before installation, then expose a local failpoint endpoint through GOFAIL_HTTP.
guide3_detail: Install Go 1.21+ and GNU Make before building.
guide3_note: This example starts etcd. Use it in a test environment and press Ctrl+C to stop.
faq2_answer: Unix-like systems only. Normal Windows installation uses upstream release archives.
faq3_answer: Release packages provide etcd, etcdctl and etcdutl. Run them with vfox exec or mise exec.
description: Manage etcd, etcdctl and etcdutl with vfox or mise. Install release binaries or build a failpoint version for robustness testing.
faq1_answer: Run vfox search etcd or mise ls-remote vfox:version-fox/vfox-etcd to find available versions.
faq4_answer: Run vfox update etcd. The plugin checks the manifest published in this repository.
